segments.text: I'm in a zero gravity plane. It looks
like I'm floating, but I'm actually free
falling. The whole flight is split up
into three phases. First, the plane
pitches up to 50° [music]
speeding up steeply for 20 seconds along
this path. And during this part, you
feel squished to the ground,
hypergravity, until the plane reaches
this exact point, and then it
dramatically slows down and basically
throws you. And as you're falling along
this arc, the plane is carefully keeping
itself perfectly around you, and you
feel weightless.
It lasts for 22 seconds. And when
[music] the plane hits this downward
angle of 42° exactly, they re-engage the
engines to speed back up and catch you.
And you feel smooshed again. This plane
does this 31 times. [music] If you want
to see what happens inside, subscribe.
